heroSummary: Most Davis School District students began Monday, August 18, 2025, on an elementary early-out schedule. Kindergarten students used August 18–19 for individually scheduled testing and began regular classes Wednesday, August 20. Secondary schools followed an A/B rotation with Wednesday late starts, while elementary schools dismissed early on Fridays. The final student day was Friday, May 22, 2026, with district-published early-out times.
calendarNotes: Most Davis students began August 18, while kindergarten used August 18–19 for individually scheduled testing before regular classes began August 20. Secondary schools followed the printed A/B rotation, with March 24 marked A/B for the ACT. Junior high and high schools used late-start Wednesdays, while elementary schools used early-dismissal Fridays. Fall Break ran October 16–17, followed by an all-school early-out day when Quarter 2 began October 20. Thanksgiving combined a November 26 teacher compensation day with the November 27–28 break. Winter Break ran December 22–January 2, and a January 5 professional day kept students out until January 6. Spring Break ran March 30–April 3, and the May 22 last day used the all-school early-out schedule.

customSections.label: How the Kindergarten Opening Worked
customSections.content: Most students began August 18. Kindergarten students did not follow a regular class schedule August 18–19; they attended individually assigned testing appointments and began regular school August 20. With school-director approval, a school could instead hold two testing days during August 11–14 and move its kindergarten teachers' professional and contract days to August 18–19.

customSections.label: Three Schedules Share the Same Calendar
customSections.content: The district PDF layers grade-band schedule rules onto the same instructional calendar. A/B letters apply to secondary students, Wednesday late starts apply to junior high and high school, and Friday early dismissals apply to elementary school. The PDF does not publish one districtwide weekly bell time.

customSections.label: Parent-Teacher Conference Options
customSections.content: Secondary conference weeks use different days by school level: high schools hold conferences Monday and Tuesday, junior high schools Wednesday and Thursday, and each school determines its schedule. Elementary schools choose two of three options and dismiss early Wednesday through Friday during each selected option, so an elementary family should not assume all three windows apply.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Davis School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Most students started Monday, August 18, 2025. Kindergarten students attended assigned testing appointments August 18–19 and began regular classes Wednesday, August 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Davis School District Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break was October 16–17, 2025. Students returned Monday, October 20 on an all-school early-out schedule: high school 12:20, junior high 1:00, and elementary 1:30.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Davis School District Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Students remained out January 5 for professional development and returned Tuesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Davis School District Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran Monday, March 30, through Friday, April 3, 2026. Students returned Monday, April 6.

calendarFaqs.q: Did every Davis elementary school use all three conference options?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Elementary schools selected two of three options: October 1–3, November 5–7, or February 11–13. Families needed their school's selected dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of school in Davis School District?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day was Friday, May 22, 2026. It was an all-school early-out day and the end of Quarter 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloadable Davis calendar include every A/B day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import of selected dates. It does not repeat daily A/B letters, Wednesday secondary late starts, or Friday elementary early dismissals.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 10, 2026, against Davis School District's calendar page, approval notice, and a visually rendered copy of the complete official 2025–26 adjusted calendar.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the adjusted Davis calendar
sourceReviewDetails: The one-page PDF was rendered and checked visually because A/B letters, grade-band rows, early-out markers, conference labels, term boundaries, and color-coded staff days carry information that text extraction alone does not preserve.

The district's December 5, 2024 notice says the calendar was board-approved and could receive slight changes after negotiations; the reviewed official file is labeled as the January 2025 adjusted calendar.
Kindergarten testing is presented as individually scheduled appointments, not as two ordinary attendance days, and the school-level alternate testing option is preserved.
Elementary conference windows are marked as options because each school selected two of the three published choices.
Recurring Wednesday, Friday, and A/B schedules are summarized rather than exported as dozens of standalone events.
The .ics file is a one-time import and does not update automatically if DSD corrects an archived date.
